parameters.name: order

decisions.chain_element: concatenation of measures of source modality X source and target modality X target

decisions.chain_element: estimate expression levels of target modality from the input modality

evidence.quote: Modality prediction aims to estimate expression levels of target modality from the input modality.

evidence.quote: using a graph neural network (GNN) on a gene similarity graph G .

decisions.rationale: R7: graph convolution is an explicit computation without a catalog operation.

decisions.rationale: R3: sinusoidal time embedding is a model-internal positional/time encoding.

decisions.rationale: R3: a learnable batch embedding is a trainable table lookup keyed by batch labels.
